operator_config.name: ErrConflict
operator_config.doc:
ErrConflict is returned by DBUpdate when expectedStatus is non-nil and
the current status in the database does not match. Callers can use
errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) to detect CAS failures.

operator_config.doc:
nonTerminalCondition is the SQL WHERE clause fragment that filters for
non-terminal batch statuses. Computed once since terminal statuses are fixed.

operator_config.name: expiryCondition
operator_config.value: colExpiry + " > 0 AND " + colExpiry + " <= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::BIGINT"
operator_config.doc: expiryCondition uses DB-side NOW() to avoid clock skew between app and database.

operator_config.name: ErrFileExists
operator_config.doc: ErrFileExists is returned when attempting to store a file that already exists.

operator_config.name: ErrFileTooLarge

operator_config.name: ErrTooManyLines
operator_config.doc: ErrTooManyLines is returned when the file exceeds the line limit.

operator_config.name: defaultDirPerm

operator_config.name: defaultTimeout

operator_config.name: pageSize
operator_config.doc: pageSize is the number of expired items to fetch per database query.

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxConcurrency
operator_config.doc: DefaultMaxConcurrency is the default number of concurrent item deletions per GC cycle.

operator_config.name: DefaultMetricsAddr
operator_config.doc: DefaultMetricsAddr is the default listen address for the metrics HTTP server.

operator_config.name: DefaultReconcilerInterval
operator_config.doc:
DefaultReconcilerInterval is the default interval between orphan reconciler cycles.
It also serves as the staleness threshold for in-flight entries.

operator_config.name: Bucket100
operator_config.doc: size bucket labels

operator_config.name: ReasonSystemError
operator_config.doc: Reason labels

operator_config.name: ResultSuccess
operator_config.doc: Result labels

operator_config.name: errCancelled
operator_config.doc:
errCancelled signals a user-initiated batch job cancellation.
Returned by preprocessor and executor when userCancelCtx is cancelled.

operator_config.name: errExpired
operator_config.doc:
errExpired signals that the batch SLO deadline was reached during execution.
Returned by executor when the SLO context expires.

operator_config.name: errFinalizeFailedOver
operator_config.doc:
errFinalizeFailedOver signals that a terminal status transition (completed,
cancelled) or an upload failed, but the fallback to failed status with
surviving file IDs succeeded. The caller must NOT call handleFailed again,
as that would overwrite file IDs with empty strings and orphan
already-uploaded files.

operator_config.name: errRequestInputRead
operator_config.value: errors.New("failed to read request from input file")
operator_config.doc:
errRequestInputRead signals a fatal failure reading a request entry from the
plan input file. Unlike per-request errors (which are embedded in output),
this prevents the entire model from processing further.

operator_config.name: errShutdown
operator_config.doc:
errShutdown signals that the processor is shutting down (SIGTERM).
The job is left in its current non-terminal state for the orphan
reconciler to detect and transition to a terminal state.

operator_config.name: inputFileName
operator_config.doc: local job artifact file names

operator_config.name: jobsDirName
operator_config.doc: folder names

operator_config.name: outputStorageNameFmt
operator_config.doc: remote storage file name format strings

operator_config.name: finalizationTimeout
operator_config.doc:
finalizationTimeout bounds how long finalizeJob waits for file uploads and DB
writes before giving up. Storage and DB clients have their own timeouts, but
this provides an explicit application-level bound — same pattern as
panicRecoveryTimeout. Declared as var (not const) so tests can shorten it.

operator_config.name: defaultHeartbeatInterval
operator_config.doc:
defaultHeartbeatInterval is the fallback heartbeat interval used when
the config value is zero. Matches ProcessorConfig.HeartbeatInterval default.

operator_config.name: panicRecoveryTimeout
operator_config.doc:
panicRecoveryTimeout bounds how long handlePanicRecovery waits for DB
operations before giving up. This prevents an unreachable database from
blocking wg.Done() and release() indefinitely, which would leak the
worker token and eventually deadlock Stop().
Declared as var (not const) so tests can shorten it.

operator_config.name: NoPrefixHash
operator_config.doc:
NoPrefixHash is used when a request has no system prompt.
Set to MaxUint32 so that no-prompt requests sort last, allowing
requests with actual system prompts to be dispatched first.

operator_config.name: safeFileNameRegex
operator_config.doc: safeFileNameRegex is a regex to replace invalid file name characters with '_'

operator_config.name: terminalStatuses
operator_config.doc:
terminalStatuses is the single source of truth for terminal batch statuses.
Declared as an array (not slice) so it cannot be appended to or resliced.

operator_config.name: MaxExpirationSeconds
operator_config.doc: MaxExpirationSeconds is the maximum allowed expiration time (30 days)

operator_config.name: MinExpirationSeconds
operator_config.doc: MinExpirationSeconds is the minimum allowed expiration time (1 hour)

operator_config.name: AttrRequestTotal
operator_config.doc:
Job-level request counts as span attributes for persistent trace-based analysis.
These complement the ephemeral Redis progress store (UpdateProgressCounts),
which is TTL-based and used for real-time status polling only.
Compile-time check: AdaptiveSemaphore implements Semaphore.

operator_config.name: ErrCap
operator_config.doc: ErrCap is returned when attempting to create a semaphore with invalid capacity.

semaphore implements the Semaphore interface using a buffered channel.
Compile-time check: semaphore implements Semaphore.

operator_config.name: rateLimitBackoffMultiplier
operator_config.doc:
rateLimitBackoffMultiplier scales the initial backoff for 429 responses.
A 429 means the server explicitly asks the client to slow down, so we
back off harder than for transient 5xx errors.
Compile-time check: InferenceHTTPClient implements InferenceClient.

operator_config.name: ErrCodeModelNotFound
operator_config.doc:
ErrCodeModelNotFound is the request-level error code written to the batch
error file when a model has no configured gateway in per-model mode.
